snippet.title: Dino Cleanup Demo | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the Dino Cleanup Steam Demo RIGHT NOW!

Clean every corner of the world to save cute dinosaurs from the flood of goop in this nostalgic 3D platformer. Dino Cleanup is a wholesome cleaning 3D platformer where you play as a cute little dinosaur with a vacuum cleaner saving a world that has been covered in toxic goop.

So many dinosaur friends are waiting for you to save them from a world covered in icky goop! Scale giant dinosaurs, discover ancient mysteries, and stop the source of the corruption. Suck up the goop and overdrive your vacuum for unique abilities, depending on the type of goop you suck up!
